title: Coming back when called
summary: From turning to their name to coming back on a long line.

stages.title: Turning to their name
stages.whatItMeans: Your dog looks your way when they hear their name, said once.
stages.whyItMatters: Every recall starts with your dog turning towards you.
stages.everydayPractice: Say their name once when they are already about to look at you, and reward the look.

gate.summary: Orients within 2 seconds of their name, said once, in low distraction.
gate.ownerCheck: In a quiet room, does {dog} look at you within a couple of seconds of hearing their name once?

stages.ifGateFails: Shorten the game, drop distractions and use a reward your dog loves.
stages.maintenance: Reward a few name responses on ordinary days.

stages.title: Coming back nearby
stages.whatItMeans: One recall word, and your dog comes to you in a quiet, enclosed space.
stages.whyItMatters: A recall that always pays off at home is the base for every place after it.
stages.everydayPractice: Call once when your dog is already heading your way, and make arriving worth it.

gate.summary: Returns to arm's reach on a 5 m long line in low distraction.
gate.ownerCheck: On a 5 metre long line somewhere quiet, does {dog} come back to arm's reach when called once?

stages.ifGateFails: Go back to the name game and shorten the distance. Don't repeat the recall word if your dog is unlikely to come.
stages.maintenance: A few rewarded recalls on ordinary walks each week.

title: Walking nicely on the lead
summary: From getting used to the lead to checking in on walks.

stages.title: Comfortable on the lead
stages.whatItMeans: Your dog is relaxed wearing the lead and walks a few steps beside you at home.
stages.whyItMatters: A dog who is comfortable on the lead can learn where the reward is.
stages.everydayPractice: Clip the lead on for a moment at home, reward, and take it off again.

gate.summary: Walks ten steps on a loose lead indoors.
gate.ownerCheck: Indoors, can {dog} walk ten steps beside you with the lead loose?

stages.ifGateFails: Fewer steps, more rewards at your side, and a quieter room.
stages.maintenance: Reward walking at your side now and then on walks.
